title: Role quiz
purpose: Three-state client quiz (intro, ten questions, scored result tier) in one section.

content.budgetRule: maxWords/maxChars = the maximum observed for the field across every reference example (schema/examples/reference/*, extracted from the rendered clone); list sizes = observed min/max. Never exceed; shorter is allowed. Long-form text in the clone is placeholder copy of the original's length.

assets.note: reference mode may use referenceRoles; generated mode must use generatedRoles (generation-safe only). See assets/asset-roles.json.

style.note: token props take token-catalog paths only (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json); allowed values = values observed in the reference examples (tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleProps).

motion.note: pattern evidence and reduced-motion fallbacks: tokens/00-foundation/motion-patterns.json

responsive.behavior: md tier: container padding 64, display type steps down, multi-column grids collapse to 1 or 2 columns
sm tier: container padding 16, single column, type at the sm preset

runtimeUi.behavior: intro -> 10 questions -> scored tier, client-side only
